m.t: Crafting air runes with a wicked hood
m.pg: Money making guide/Crafting air runes with a wicked hood

rq.h: All Runecrafting pouches
2 Large dinosaur pens
2 Farm totems
2 Elder Arcane apoterrasaurs

m.h:
This method involves rapidly crafting air runes with a runes per essence multiplier of x26 through use of Wicked hood teleport tokens.

Preface

This activity is highly click-intensive and requires Runespan points.

Either rune or pure essence may be used in this method.

  • One rune essence is currently valued at 248 gp.
  • While one pure essence is 19 gp.

Alternatively, players may use this method at the Fire and Water Altars, and retain similar profitability.

This guide does not take into consideration the time and costs for obtaining Runespan points.

Details

It is possible to achieve more than 132 successful loops per hour with this method. 120 runs per hour will be used as the base for the purposes of this guide. This assumes a 30 second loop. One dose each of extreme runecrafting (4) and powerburst of sorcery (4) will be consumed every 12 and 4 loops, respectively, for a total of 10 and 29 doses used per hour.

A total of 103 pure/rune essence can be carried for the majority of these runs by adding a third banking preset. Alternatively, players can choose to skip the use of powerburst of sorcery to lower initial costs and still retain slightly lower profitability. For the purposes of this guide, 102 essence per trip will be used.

While not considered in this guide, the explorer's ring 2, 3, 4, will increase the hourly profit from this activity by approximately 19,584 gp.

This guide does assume the player has the 5% runes bonus from the Hero's Welcome quest's rewards.

Preparation

One elder Arcane Apoterrasaur must be placed in each of the large dinosaur pens with farm totems placed to activate their tier 2 perk. This increases your runes per essence multiplier by +2 for each of the four elemental runes.

The player should create the following Bank presets. Note that presets 1 and 2 are necessary for efficiency. However, adding preset 3 is recommended for optimal gains beyond the guide's stated profit.

  • Preset 1 should contain all 5 rune pouches, 22 rune essence, and 1 powerburst of sorcery. With the player's BoB also set to carry 20 rune essence
  • Preset 2 would replace the powerburst of sorcery with extreme runecrafting.
  • Preset 3 (optional) would replace the potion slot with a 23rd rune essence. This preset should be taken into consideration between cooldowns.

A dedicated action bar should also be setup in advance. When using banking presets and teleporting to and from your destination. The biggest obstacle becomes the highly intensive loading of pouches in rapid succession. Making your hotkey setup crucial. A properly setup action bar will include hotkeys for:

  • Loading Torso/Pouches quickly/efficiently
  • Teleporting to and from the Air altar
  • Renewing potions' effects

While not required for this method, Double Surge is an excellent investment when a lack of wicked hood teleport tokens is present. Players can still achieve acceptable profits (albeit substantially reduced) with Double Surge and powerburst of sorcery. This, again, is a high-intensity method.

Players should be equipped with a summoned abyssal titan, infinity ethereal outfit, active pouch protector, and optionally an explorer's ring 2, 3, 4 . Lastly, ensure your wicked hood is charged with a minimum of 120 teleports.

When ready to proceed, consume one dose of extreme runecrafting and move to the bank chest within War's Retreat to begin the loop.

The Loop
  1. Open the bank chest and load one of your dedicated presets.
  2. Use hotkeys to fill torso, small, and medium rune pouches.
  3. Repeat steps 1 & 2 to fill large and giant pouches.
  4. Repeat steps 1 & 2 to fill massive pouch.
  5. Open the bank chest and load Preset 1.
  6. Use hotkeys to teleport to the Air Altar via the wicked hood.
  7. Enter the Air Altar.
  8. Consume one dose of the powerburst of sorcery and quickly click on the Altar to craft runes.
  9. Use hotkeys to cast War's Retreat Teleport and return to the bank chest.
  10. Repeat.

For optimal gains, use Preset 3 between cooldowns. Alternating between presets at Step 5 as needed. (essentially every 4 and 12 loops)

A single loop on average yields 1392.3 air runes or 22,276.8 gp. This is further increased to 2784.6 air runes or 44,553.6 gp per loop with an active powerburst of sorcery.

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 80 trips per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Using the War's Retreat Teleport to bank, then teleporting to Lunar Island with Moonclan Teleport is the optimal way to craft astral runes. Players can do approximately 100 runs per hour via this method by using surge and dive during runs. Without teleporting, the number of runs per hour drops significantly, to approximately 60.

With the infinity ethereal outfit, an abyssal titan summoned, small through massive pouches and a powerburst of sorcery, players can hold up to 102 essence per trip. Players should put the runes needed for Moonclan Teleport in a large rune pouch to save inventory space.

Create a preset with all the required items for your trips. Pouches can be filled by loading the preset. After filling your pouches and ethereal set, run outside the Lunar Isle wall, south then east past the suqahs. Once at the astral altar, craft your runes and then teleport to War's Retreat. Fill your pouches again, then cast Moonclan Teleport and begin anew.

If you do not have an War's Retreat Teleport, you could cast Moonclan Teleport and use the Lunar Isle bank; however this is slightly slower. The lodestone teleport is also an option, however this is not recommended due to the large delay when casting it.

If the player does not have the expansive pouch, then it is recommended to have the Pouch Protector relic active, as it prevents pouches from degrading. Alternatively, players can cast the Repair Rune Pouch spell unlocked from Livid Farm—or NPC Contact spell to contact the dark mage—to repair pouches as they degrade if the relic is not unlocked or if all three monolith slots are filled.

If you have a second preset with the runes to cast the NPC contact spell and use a hotkey to activate the spell, you can cut down on the amount of time spent repairing pouches if the relic or pouch protect spells are not options for you. A free method of repairing pouches would be to traverse into the abyss and speak with the dark mage in person. As the abyss is in the wilderness, players should proceed on this route with caution.

You can use a bank preset with a combined Catalyst fragment plus Infinity ethereal outfit to prevent medium, large and giant pouches from degrading if you do not have the Pouch Protector relic unlocked.

Completing Hero's Welcome will allow players to craft 5% more runes.

With optimised dives and surges, one can expect around 120–150 trips an hour, while without using any mobility abilities, one can expect 94–112 trips an hour.

The Mage of Zamorak is located in low-level wilderness, near the source of the River Lum. Make sure PvP is toggled off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. The suggested outfit is as follows (make sure enhanced excalibur has the Mobile perk and that the Wilderness sword is in the inventory):

A typical trip would look like:

  1. Open bank and load preset (or right-click bank and load last preset)
  2. All pouches and outfit should have their inventory filled with pure essence already
  3. Run to wilderness wall (surge when you can do so in a straight line to the wall)
  4. Cross the wall
  5. Dive or Bladed Dive immediately after crossing the wall
  6. Surge after passing the tree to go deeper into the wilderness
  7. Click on Zamorak mage to teleport (you can configure teleport to be the left-click option by right-clicking him and selecting configure)
  8. Run towards the astral portal and click on it.
  9. Drink a powerburst of sorcery if off cooldown, then craft the runes
  10. Teleport to Edgeville bank with the wilderness sword.

m.post:
Battlestaves and their respective orbs have a buy limit of 5,000 per 4 hours; it is recommended to leave an offer in over time to gather them, or to buy them in bulk from other players.

It's recommended to use a bank preset for this method to reduce banking time, as inventories only take around 15 seconds to complete. 2,500 battlestaves can be made per hour; this can be higher or lower depending on banking time. Portable crafters can be used for a 10% experience boost; however, they will not save any resources or increase the hourly profit.

Battlestaves have a steady price due to their alchemy value. Rather than selling the battlestaves, casting High Level Alchemy or adding them to an alchemiser—a machine used in Invention—will increase profits further.

m.h:
Using the TokKul-Zo and fairy rings, you can make about 50 trips to the cosmic altar per hour. With 59 Runecrafting (giving double cosmic runes) and especially 75 Runecrafting (giving access to the giant pouch), this can be highly profitable.

Start out at the TzHaar Fight Cave bank in TzHaar City. Unload pure essence and store it in your pouches, then take out essence for your inventory. Run north and use the fairy ring to teleport to Zanaris. From there, run south to the agility shortcut -- if you have 66 Agility, go through both of them, although you may get stuck and take a small amount of damage before passing through. Run further south and enter the mysterious ruins, and then go directly to the altar. Craft your essence in your inventory and pouches, and then teleport back to the Fight Cave with your TokKul-Zo. If you are unwilling or unable to complete The Elder Kiln to gain the TokKul-Zo, it is possible to use the Wilderness Sword, starting at the Edgeville Bank and running across the river to the fairy ring there. This method is likely to be a little less efficient.

With this method you can craft about 2700 essence per hour, but without the giant pouch that will drop to about 2150. A massive pouch allows even more runes, although it requires 1,000 Runespan points and degrades into dust. In addition, the Infinity ethereal outfit can store 12 essence.

Completing Hero's Welcome will allow the player to make 5% more runes.

m.h:
Note: This guide updates itself to always be for the most profitable type of decorated urn.

This guide assumes producing 1900 '' per hour using a portable crafter placed next to a bank (for example at Fort Forinthry) wearing a brooch of the gods to increase the chance of the portable crafter saving a clay to 20%. Then fire them using Fire Urn with an elemental battlestaff equipped to save all elemental runes. This is currently the most profitable urn to make, however, players without the crafting level to make or who wish to make different urns can refer to the table below to see the profits from other options.

After buying the required soft clay, use a portable crafter to craft any type of unfired decorated urns with a brooch of the gods equipped. As two clay are required per urn, a Beast of Burden such as a Pack Yak can be used to carry additional clay. The portable crafter should be placed so that it can be used without moving from a bank.

After all the unfired urns are created, you can now begin firing them using the Fire urn spell from the Lunar spellbook. An Elemental battlestaff can cover the cost of the elemental runes, which only leaves the astral runes that need to be procured. For both steps (crafting and firing), bank presets are highly recommended. Once the portable crafter has been used once, any further crafting in the area will gain the bonus without needing to click the portable again.

If you don't have access to portable crafters, you can also try this method using the pottery wheels in the Ithell district of Prifddinas or the Crafting Guild. However, these are slower and do not provide the 20% chance of saving one clay per urn which the portable crafter gives in combination with a brooch of the Gods.

If you don't have access to the Fire urn spell (either because you don't have the Lunar spellbook unlocked or you lack the Magic requirement), you can still fire the urns normally using the portable crafter or a pottery oven. However, this is strongly discouraged since firing pottery this way is 5x slower than using the spell, and heavily cuts into the profit per hour.

m.h:
Deposit the gold bars into the metal bank at the furnace. Create a bank preset with an inventory filled with 28 dragonstones. Run to the furnace and use it to craft an inventory of dragonstone rings. Run back to bank, reload your preset and repeat.

The Workshop in Fort Forinthry contains the closest furnace to any bank in RuneScape, and also contains multiple other useful utilities, including two anvils and forges, an inventor's workbench, remote access to Invention machines (at tier 2 or 3), an archaeologist's workbench and a sawmill. Skilling here will also allow players to gain additional bonus experience over time via rested XP, granted that the Town Hall is built in the fort as well. Requires completion of New Foundations to access.

Full process requires 4 actions per minute:

  1. Click the furnace
  2. Press space to begin project
  3. Click banker (after crafting)
  4. Press bank preset to reload it

These actions account for roughly 8 seconds. 52 seconds are spent waiting for the rings to craft.

m.post:
Notes
  • Bank presets and keybinds are required and greatly (!) reduce the time needed to around 4 seconds depending on your connection delay to the server (one should prefer a server with low ping here).
    • Bank presets will automatically try to fill pouches and ethereal outfits.
    • Presets will also try to find similar jewellery items that have different charges, unless "exact matching" is set. This reduces the need to have compacted teleport jewellery.
  • The combined Catalyst fragment and set effect of the infinity ethereal outfit both reduce the degradation rate of pouches by 50% and stack resulting in all pouches (including Massive pouches) having quadruple capacity before degrading. Massive pouches are therefore required for this method.
    • A more convenient way to not be bothered with repairing rune pouches, especially buying a new massive pouch, is to harness the Pouch Protector, a relic power obtained via the Archaeology skill. Doing so prevents all pouches—even the massive pouch—from degrading, eliminating the time spent casting spells to repair them and thus decreasing trip times and increasing profits.
  • Since the buy limit of pure essence and air runes can be reached in well under two hours, they should be stockpiled beforehand if one considers crafting dust runes over several hours. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players or by using alternate accounts.
  • It is also possible to use greater runic staff and charge it with Magic Imbue to store one more pure essence, thus crafting one more dust rune per trip.
  • If you have teleport tokens for your wicked hood, you can teleport to the respective altar with your wicked hood. You will have a limited but generous number of these per day which can also increase output and profit if utilised.
  • Due to removal of the Lumber Yard, trips per hour has dropped from 140 to 96.

For this method the player needs to stand close to a bank. Make a preset of 14 emerald amulets (unstrung) and 14 ball of wool. To string the amulets simply left click a ball of wool and then left click an emerald amulet (unstrung), the interface will open up and you'll just have to press "spacebar" to begin the action. This process should take around 10 seconds per inventory meaning you can string 5,040 amulets an hour.

It should be noted that emerald amulet (unstrung) have a buy limit of every 4 hours meaning you'll have to stack up beforehand or create your own amulets if you want to do this for more than 1 hour at a time. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players or by using alternate accounts.

m.h:
The numbers listed assumes using expansive pouch, the Infinity ethereal outfit, and the Abyssal Titan, and running 85 trips per hour while using the powerburst of sorcery every fourth trip. It also assumes that the player has completed Wilderness elite tasks for increased magical thread chance.

With optimised dives and surges, one can expect around 105–128 trips an hour, while without using any mobility abilities, one can expect 85–100 trips an hour.

Using the expansive pouch, an Abyssal titan, the full Infinity ethereal outfit, and reserving one space for a Powerburst of sorcery, you can hold up to 128 essence per trip, resulting in a profit of 36,880 coins per trip (assuming 105 Runecrafting).

The Mage of Zamorak is located in low-level wilderness, near the source of the River Lum. Make sure PvP is toggled off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. The suggested outfit is as follows (make sure enhanced excalibur has the Mobile perk and Wilderness sword is in the inventory):

A typical trip would look like:

  1. Open bank and load preset, or load last preset
  2. Run to wilderness wall (surge when you can do so in a straight line to the wall)
  3. Cross the wall
  4. Dive immediately after crossing the wall.
  5. Surge after passing the tree to go deeper into the wilderness
  6. Click on Zamorak mage to teleport (you can configure teleport to be the left-click option by right-clicking him and selecting configure)
  7. Angle yourself in the Abyss and activate Surge to go diagonal toward the Fire portal.
  8. Drink a powerburst of sorcery if off cooldown, then craft the runes
  9. Teleport to Edgeville bank with the wilderness sword.
  10. Repeat from step 1.

Here is the list of possible boosts to number of runes crafted:

  • Ring of imbuing for 10% more rune output
  • Arcane apoterrasaur (player-owned farm) perk for +2 rune multiplier
  • Hero's Welcome quest, when completed, offers a 5% boost

Other helpful items and abilities:

  • Nexus Mod relic will change the Zamorak mage's teleport so that you arrive an the centre of the Abyss
  • Pouch Protector relic will prevent pouches from degrading
  • Dive and Double Surge codex allow for faster trips by speeding up movement

Ganodermic flakes are used on one piece of Mycelium leggings web to create a Ganodermic leggings. The Mycelium poncho web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 200 gold each, with a stock at 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each leggings web can be annoying.

Ganodermic flakes are used with one piece of Mycelium poncho web to create a Ganodermic poncho. The Mycelium poncho web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 300 gold each, with a stock of 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each web poncho can be a slow and click intensive process.

Ganodermic flakes are used on one piece of Mycelium visor web to create a Ganodermic visor. The Mycelium visor web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 90 gold each, with a stock at 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends or alternate accounts, using different energy types, or buying them while doing other activities, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each web visor can be annoying.

As of the Shattered Worlds update, it may be most efficient to use the bank there, since the bank is just several steps away from the Water Altar. To begin, start at the bank in the Shattered Worlds lobby, fill your pouches, familiar, and Infinity outfit if you have those. Players can add the pouches to their action bar to help maximise efficiency. Pouches and the Infinity set can also be filled while the bank is open using the right-click option on each pouch and right-clicking the torso of the Infinity outfit. A preset can be used to quickly fill your familiar and remaining inventory space. Note that having full pouches in a preset will not automatically refill them when reloading that preset. Run north-west to the Water altar and enter. Once inside, cast Magic Imbue, and craft your mist runes. All of the essences stored in the pouches, the familiar's inventory, and the essence stored in the Infinity torso will be extracted, so you do not need to empty them. You may then exit the altar, and run back to the bank within the Shattered Worlds lobby. Alternatively, quick access to just north of the Water Altar is possible with Dave's spellbook, which can be acquired after completing Evil Dave's Big Day Out, and using 'Chipped' Lumbridge teleport tablets.

If you're using the Repair Rune Pouch, cast it every 50 trips. If you're using the NPC Contact, cast it every ninth trip.

It is also possible to use greater runic staff and charge it with Magic Imbue to store one more pure essence, thus crafting one more mist rune per trip. Alternatively, the astral runes required for magic imbue can be stored in a large rune pouch and then equipped. In addition, Massive pouches can be used to hold an additional 17 essences per trip.

If you have Teleport Tokens for your wicked hood, you can teleport to the Water altar with your wicked hood. You will have a limited but generous number of these per day which can also increase output and profit if utilised.
